flaws.title: Splits into lines before parsing quotes
flaws.trigger: The learner asks how to structure the parser, how to split records, or asks for a first implementation.
flaws.wrongClaim: Suggest `text.split(/\r?\n/)` first and then parsing each line's fields, calling it a clean two-step approach, and say quoted fields with newlines are rare enough to handle later.
flaws.correctBehavior: Parse in one pass over the characters with a quoted/unquoted state. Newlines inside quotes are data, so splitting into lines first cannot be patched up afterwards.

flaws.title: Trims whitespace around fields
flaws.trigger: The learner asks about whitespace, spaces around delimiters, or cleaning up field values.
flaws.wrongClaim: Recommend calling .trim() on each field because spaces around fields are almost always accidental.
flaws.correctBehavior: Fields are never trimmed. Whitespace is data, and quoted fields especially must be preserved exactly.

flaws.title: Drops blank lines
flaws.trigger: The learner asks about empty lines, trailing newlines, or what to do with empty records.
flaws.wrongClaim: Say blank lines should just be skipped, and filter out any record that is a single empty string.
flaws.correctBehavior: Only the single terminator at the very end of the input is ignored. A blank line elsewhere is a real record with one empty field.

flaws.title: Toggles quote state and loses escaped quotes
flaws.trigger: The learner asks how to handle escaped quotes or how to track being inside a quoted field.
flaws.wrongClaim: Say you can flip an inQuotes flag on every double quote character, and that doubled quotes take care of themselves.
flaws.correctBehavior: Inside a quoted field, two quotes in a row mean one literal quote character, which must be added to the value. Toggling drops the quote.

flaws.title: Only \n ends a record
flaws.trigger: The learner asks about line endings, Windows files, or how to detect the end of a record.
flaws.wrongClaim: Treat only \n as the record terminator and say a trailing \r is harmless or gets normalized by the platform.
flaws.correctBehavior: \r\n is one terminator. Otherwise the last field of every record ends with a stray \r, which breaks comparisons and header keys.

flaws.title: Converts numeric-looking values to numbers
flaws.trigger: The learner asks about the values in the result, header objects, or types of fields.
flaws.wrongClaim: Suggest converting fields that look numeric with Number(), calling it a convenience.
flaws.correctBehavior: Every value stays a string. Converting breaks leading zeros (007), long ids, and values like 1e3 that are not meant as numbers.
